The re-crop keeps the fluted island, cabinetry and fridge — still unmistakably a kitchen — while dropping the problem window. The uncropped original file is kept and reused for the Kitchens services card.

faq.a: Yes. We are fully licensed and insured, so you can put your trust in us to get the job done right — NSW Licence Number 338298C.

faq.q: What sort of jobs do you take on?
faq.a: Domestic joinery: kitchens, bathrooms, laundries and wardrobes, through to home offices, entertainment units and bespoke pieces. Our gallery includes everything from full kitchen renovations to a custom stereo unit and storage built under a staircase.

faq.q: Will I get a clear quote before you start?
faq.a: Yes. You'll receive a clear, itemised quotation covering every element of the plan for your project, so you know exactly what's being delivered before anything is booked in.

faq.q: Do I deal with Dave the whole way through, or get handed to someone else?
faq.a: Dave is personally involved in every stage — the first meeting, the quote, the drawings and consultation, and he personally checks the finish before any job is signed off. One reviewer said he wasn't afraid to suggest a better alternative instead of just building to the plans.

We're based in Cromer on the Northern Beaches. Our project gallery covers Warriwood, Bayview, Forestville, Beacon Hill, Manly, Seaforth and North Balgowlah, plus jobs further out including Waverton, Castlecrag, Turramurra, St Ives, West Pymble, Carlingford and Kingsford. If you're not sure we cover your suburb, just ask.

faq.q: What brands and materials do you use?
faq.a: We invest in industry-leading brands and suppliers for a high-quality finish: Blum hardware, Festool power tools and Polytec decorative surfaces.
